alex: small UX/engineering q: when someone saves a per-route view that filters by model, should we persist "snapshot" routing (region/tier) or resolve routing live on open/apply? tradeoffs: reproducibility vs brittle pinning. cc @jamie @nina

jamie: my vote: snapshot at save-time + a live-resolve option. default to snapshot so analysts can reproduce numbers. show a clear badge if live differs.

nina: agree on badge. also require we emit telemetry for both snapshot and resolved routing on apply (saved_view_applied includes snapshot_routing, resolved_routing, sample_rate). without that we can't trace regressions.

sam: engineering concern: snapshots reference capacity pools that may disappear. need resolver fallback policy: try snapshot -> route-default -> cheapest-compatible. surface failure reason to user.

alex: proposal: saved object stores small snapshot blob + resolution_policy: "snapshot|soft|hard". UI: preview shows both snapshot and live-resolve with cost/latency delta.

jamie: API sketch (stringified fields in DB): {v: "1", route: "r-11", model: "open-13b@rev", snapshot: "us-west-2/dedicated-m", resolution_policy: "soft", sampling: "0.05"} (we'll keep as small strings).

nina: telemetry events to add: saved_view_saved (with snapshot fields), saved_view_previewed (live_vs_snapshot boolean), saved_view_applied (resolved_routing_id, snapshot_present, sample_rate).

ci-bot: background job queued: saved-view-migration @2790012360 (job/4012).

alex: ok owners: jamie -> UI mock + badge copy; nina -> telemetry schema; sam -> resolver fallback & migration plan. i'll document decisions in the ticket.

jamie: will gate live-resolve preview behind feature flag and A/B 10% first.

alex: thanks all, closing.
